pages.en:
“Ah... ngh—”

My already-boiling head gets tossed back onto the stove.

The way Tohsaka looks right now is so unfair it ought to earn her a dozen yellow cards at once.

“W-wait. Wait, wait, wait, wait...!
How did we even get to this!? We’re talking about sex! Sex, Tohsaka! That’s what people do when they’re in love! That’s how you make kids! You get naked and hold each other! You can’t do something like that with me!”

I babble on with my brain in ruins.

My hands are drenched in sweat, and my eyes can barely focus anymore.

And yet—

No matter what my mouth is saying, my body is reacting in exactly the opposite way.

I’ve been desperately forcing myself not to look at her, not to think about her that way, and now I can’t tear my eyes off Tohsaka.

pages.en:
Her soft-looking breasts.

Her long, smooth black hair.

The delicate curve from her neck down to her shoulders, slender but somehow still supple.

The fresh, bare thighs extending below her skirt.

My eyes keep getting drawn helplessly to every part of her that reminds me she’s a girl—

“........................”

She stares right back at me.

“Ah—uh...”

...I know.

If this gives me a way to fight Gilgamesh, and it means Saber doesn’t have to be put in danger, then I should do it.

We’re magi. If this is what it takes to win, I have no right to object.

But even so—

“........”

I swallow hard.

I desperately patch my reason back together, one step before I lose control of myself completely.

pages.en:
“—!”

I draw in a long breath.

Calm down. Calm down.

If this really is the only option left to us, then I have to make up my mind too.

pages.en:
“—Sorry. If you’re really okay with it, Tohsaka... then please.
If this gives me even a chance of beating him, then I shouldn’t be hesitating.”

I force out the words with all the courage I can muster and meet her gaze.

“...I’m the one who should apologize. I didn’t realize you’d hate the idea this much.
...If I’d known, I would’ve explained it a little more gradually.”

Tohsaka lowers her eyes slightly, looking awkward.

And that makes me—

pages.en:
“What...?”

“I said that’s not it. I like you, Tohsaka. There’s no way I hate the idea. It’s the opposite—I’m so happy I can barely breathe. This is practically a dream come true.”

“........”

“But—that’s exactly why I hated the idea of doing it just because it was some kind of contract.”

My face is burning.

It’s so hot I half expect it to burst into flames, but for some reason my mind keeps finding the words.

pages.en:
“...Um. Are you saying...”

“Yeah. I wanted to be close to you without any of that stuff hanging over us. That’s why doing it like this feels like cheating.”

I say it.

I actually say it with my brain boiled to mush.

I barely have any reason left, but that one thing is true, and I tell the girl in front of me exactly that.

“........”

...Tohsaka’s eyes are painful to meet.

“........................”

I get uncomfortable, look away from her, and scratch my cheek.

—Then.

“Wha—”

Something suddenly touches my lips.

“Hehe. I kissed you.”

“————!!!? T-T-Tohsaka...!”

I jerk my head back in a panic.

Maybe she finds my reaction funny. After brushing her lips lightly against mine, Tohsaka—
